network_status.network: Nuovo ponte La Piana sul torrente Dragone
network_status.summary_it: La fonte provinciale attribuisce la necessità di sostituzione del Ponte La Piana ai danni prodotti da piene ripetute, ma non conferma un singolo crollo il 31 dicembre 2009 né pubblica una misura dell'evento. Data e dinamica devono essere riallineate prima di associare idrometria.
network_status.summary_en: The provincial source attributes replacement of Ponte La Piana to damage from repeated floods but does not confirm a single collapse on 31 December 2009 or publish an event measurement. Date and failure chronology must be reconciled before hydrometry can be associated.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
